text: Call Anand Kamalnayan Pandit first. He is a promoter of Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited, and the filing shows cash in hand of ₹572.96 Cr, settled 5 Nov 2026 after the 4 Nov 2026 trade. The facts are high confidence, and this is a completed settlement rather than an expected payment. The brief also includes other people with cash in hand, but Anand is the first name in today’s call queue.
